question: Gurmeet Bawa, who received the Padma Bhushan posthumously in 2022, hails from which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Punjab**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gurmeet Bawa **was a renowned Punjabi folk singer known for her powerful voice and unique singing style.
 
• She was celebrated for her **ability to sing *hek*, a traditional Punjabi singing technique** where she could hold a note for an extended period. She played a significant role in promoting Punjabi folk music on the global stage.
 
• In recognition of her immense contribution to Indian music, Gurmeet Bawa was awarded the **Padma Bhushan posthumously in 2022**, one of the highest civilian honors in India.
 
• She hailed from the state of **Punjab**, where she was deeply connected to the cultural roots and traditions of Punjabi music.
